steps.what: Show the stored duty for this cooling or ventilation system.
Design integrated mechanical cooling or natural ventilation systems.
File the accepted energy system design.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the duty already stored for this building. The mechanical engineer designs the integrated mechanical system or the alternative, such as mechanical cooling with natural ventilation, to improve energy efficiency. The duty is not the design. Only the design the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A cooling design was filed against a duty that belonged to a different building.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored duty can be opened. The design still has to be drawn by the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A load the duty does not state still has to be designed for by the engineer, or refused.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer designs the system. The duty is the requirement already stored.
tasks.altitude: The design stays with the engineer. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Use an energy design this mechanical engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: A duty line is not the cooling design.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored duty is a lookup. It does not design a cooling system, a ventilation system, or an integrated alternative.
Filing a design before the engineer accepts that version would store a system nobody drew.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The duty id already stored for this building. The design geometry is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the duty in the document store before starting the design.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether cooling duties and ventilation duties share one record.
research_questions: Who confirms the duty is the one for this building?

already_counted.description: Designing the energy system stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop duties whose building record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: building id, duty id, and the design version the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still designs the mechanical, cooling, or natural ventilation system. Only opening a duty that was already stored, and filing the design already accepted, is removed. A duty line saves none of the design.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Calculate energy losses for buildings from stored pressure gauges.
Use combustion analyzers or pressure gauges where no reading is stored.
File the accepted energy loss figure.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} calculates an energy loss only when the building id and the gauge or analyzer reading are already stored for that building. Analyzer and gauge runtime are not counted. The mechanical engineer takes any missing reading and checks that the figure is this building. A computed loss can still be the wrong building. Only the accepted figure is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A loss was reported from a gauge reading that belonged to a different building.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored reading can be calculated. The engineer still takes the readings that are not stored and still checks the figure.
tasks.still_hard: A building with no stored reading still has to be measured by the engineer with the analyzer or the gauge.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer measures and checks. The calculation is arithmetic on readings already stored, and it can be the wrong building.
tasks.altitude: Measuring and checking stay with the engineer. Gauge runtime is not treated as saved labour, and the figure is filed only after acceptance.

reach.task: Use a loss figure this engineer has accepted for this building.
reach.learn: A computed loss is not proof it was this building.

evidence.claim: An energy loss from a stored gauge or analyzer reading is arithmetic. A figure can be computed and still be the wrong building.
Analyzer and gauge runtime are not the engineer's labour. Filing the figure before the engineer accepts it would store a number nobody checked.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The building id and the reading, already stored together. A missing reading stops the calculation for that building. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Calculate from the stored reading for this building. Do not type a reading from another building.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether combustion-analyzer readings and pressure-gauge readings share one field.
research_questions: Who attaches a reading to a building id before it can be used?

already_counted.description: Taking missing readings and checking the figure stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop readings whose building record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: building id and the reading the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still takes readings that are not already stored and still checks that the loss figure belongs to this building. Only arithmetic on a reading already stored, and filing the accepted figure, is removed. Analyzer and gauge runtime are not counted. A missing reading saves none of the measurement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored energy use for this building.
Recommend utility or energy services that minimize carbon footprints.
File the accepted energy service recommendation.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} shows energy use already stored for this building. The mechanical engineer recommends the utility or energy service that would minimize the carbon footprint. A missing use figure is not invented, and the screen does not pick the service. Only the recommendation the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A service was recommended from a footprint number that had never been stored.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored energy use can be opened. The recommendation still belongs to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A building whose use was never stored still has to be judged without an invented footprint.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recommends the service. A blank use figure is not a small footprint.
tasks.altitude: The recommendation stays with the engineer. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Quote a service recommendation this engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: A blank use figure is not a low footprint.

evidence.claim: Opening stored energy use is a lookup. It does not recommend a utility or an energy service.
A carbon footprint that was not stored is not invented. Filing the recommendation before the engineer accepts it would store a choice nobody made.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The building id and the energy-use figure already stored. A footprint number is shown only when it is already stored. None is invented. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the use figure from the data platform before the recommendation. Do not type a footprint that is not stored.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether utility use and on-site energy use share one figure.
research_questions: Who is allowed to store an energy-use figure for a building?

already_counted.description: Recommending the energy service stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop use figures whose building record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: building id and the service sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still recommends the utility or energy service. Only opening energy use already stored, and filing the recommendation already accepted, is removed. A missing figure saves none of the recommendation, and none is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the crew already assigned to this production work.
Perform personnel supervision of production workers and technicians.

tasks.design: The {PROJECT} record shows the crew already assigned. The mechanical engineer supervises the production workers, technicians, technologists, or other engineers in the conversation. The list is not a score, a ranking, or a monitor of how they work. The screen does not evaluate anyone. A list with no names leaves the supervision with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A crew list was treated as a rating of the people on it.
tasks.enabler_now: The assigned crew can be opened. The supervision still takes the engineer with the people.
tasks.still_hard: A skill gap the list does not show still has to be seen by the engineer, and it is not stored as a score.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer supervises. The list is the assignment already made, not a judgement of the person.
tasks.altitude: Supervision stays in person. The crew list is not a score and is not an automatic decision about staff.

reach.learn: An assignment is not a rating of the worker.

evidence.claim: Opening the crew already assigned is a lookup. It does not supervise anyone.
Supervision of workers is not a score, a ranking, or an automatic decision about staff. The engineer does not grade them.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The crew id and the names already assigned. The screen does not store a score, a rank, or a behaviour note. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the assignment on the project record. Do not open a rating form.
unknowns: Whether technicians and other engineers appear on the same assignment list.
research_questions: Who assigns the crew before the engineer supervises the work?

already_counted.description: Supervising the people stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop names whose assignment has ended.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still supervises the production workers, technicians, technologists, or other engineers in person. Only opening the crew already assigned is removed. The list is not a score, and a name saves none of the supervision.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The mechanical engineer still designs the energy system, still checks the loss figure, still recommends the energy service, and still supervises the people. A stored number can be shown. It does not decide, and supervision is not a score.
reach: Energy managers read a design this engineer has accepted, and a duty line is not that design.
Production workers are supervised in person. A crew list is not a rating.
skills_to_grow: Design the cooling or ventilation system for the duty that was actually stored.
Check that a loss figure uses this building's own gauge readings.
Supervise people without scoring, ranking, or monitoring them.
role.ambitious_version: Energy design, loss checks, service recommendations, and supervision stay with the engineer. Stored readings and crew lists only show what was already recorded.
